description: Append an audit line after Cloudflare deploy tools run. It does not send notifications; use /deploy's Slack step for that.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); tool=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null) || tool=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_name") or "unknown")' 2>/dev/null) || tool=unknown; printf '[%s] devops-flow deploy tool completed: %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$tool" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/devops-deploy-audit.log" 2>/dev/null || true
